description: Defines the ChannelsPostCreate class for automating UI interactions with the post creation component in Mattermost, including message input, file attachment, emoji picker, and message sending.

classes.name: ChannelsPostCreate
classes.description: A class encapsulating UI interactions for creating and sending posts in Mattermost, including handling message input, attachments, emojis, and message priority.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Waits until the post creation container and input are visible.

methods.name: writeMessage
methods.description: Writes a message into the input box without sending.

methods.name: getInputValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the message input.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends the message currently in the input box.

methods.name: postMessage
methods.description: Composes and sends a message, optionally attaching files.

methods.name: waitUntilFilePreviewContains
methods.description: Waits until the file preview contains specified files.
